description: Use this when a business owner wants help replying to a customer review on Google, Instagram, TripAdvisor or a delivery app, good or bad, for example 'how do I reply to a 1-star review about slow service?'. Returns Suara's free reply templates for that situation (with [brackets] to fill in), the rules for a good reply and what never to do. Fill the brackets only with details the owner gives you; never promise refunds, freebies or discounts in a public reply.

situation.description: What the review is about, optional, e.g. '5 stars no words', 'food was cold', 'rude review'. Leave out to see every situation.

name: review_reply_templates
title: Review reply templates
